# Generation workflow

## Copy

```bash
uvx copier copy --trust ./template <dest>
```

`--trust` is required because post-copy `_tasks` run shell commands. Minimum Copier: **9.4.0**.

## Backend task sequence

| Step | Command | When |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `uv sync --all-packages --no-install-project` | backend + **copy** |
| 2 | `uv run dx new-service {{ first_service }} --with-example` | not `polyrepo_kit` |
| 3 | `uv run dx new-saas {{ first_service }}` | saas + **not** microservices (monolith **or** polyrepo_service) |
| 4 | `uv run dx new-service identity --with-saas && … billing --with-saas` | monorepo + microservices + saas |
| 5 | `uv sync --all-packages` | backend **copy and update** |
| 6 | Ruff format + check (`\|\| true`) | copy |
| 7 | `git init -b main`, stage, `pre-commit install` | copy |

## Frontend task sequence

1. `pnpm install || (npm install -g pnpm && pnpm install)`
2. `pnpm dx check` (best effort)
3. `git init` + stage

## What gets generated (backend highlights)

- `packages/platform-kit/` (unless polyrepo service — kit is a dependency)
- `packages/contracts/` when Kafka/micro shapes need shared events
- `services/<name>/` with Alembic, Dockerfile, example `items` module
- `compose.yaml` with Postgres (+ Redis for SaaS, + Kafka when selected)
- `dx` CLI entry, pre-commit, GitHub Actions, AGENTS.md / AI configs

## What gets generated (frontend highlights)

- `apps/web/` Vite SPA with core routes
- `packages/ui-kit/` (`@aham/ui-kit`)
- Example `items` feature (list + detail)
- pnpm workspace, dx CLI, CI, AGENTS.md / AI configs

## After generation checklist

**Backend**

```bash
cp .env.example services/<service>/.env   # polyrepo_service: .env at repo root
docker compose up -d
uv run dx db upgrade <service>
uv run dx run <service>
```

**Frontend**

```bash
cp .env.example .env
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```
